title: ChatGPT Configurator: Open Source API Config Made Easy
excerpt: Discover how the Ydata ChatGPT Configurator, an open-source tool built in Rust, simplifies ChatGPT and Codex API configuration. It offers one-click setup, cross-platform support, white-label rebranding, and enterprise customization, drastically lowering technical barriers for developers and businesses.
